name: pennycrab
description: The crab that counts your pennies: routes subagents to cheaper models, stops runaway ones, keeps the prompt cache warm, and shows it all in a live pane

router.title: Subagent router
router.description: prudent: Explore and general-purpose run on Sonnet when your session runs on Opus or Fable. aggressive: Explore runs on Haiku at low effort. off: subagents inherit your model.

budget.title: Subagent budget (USD)
budget.description: The most one subagent may spend before the guard asks it to hand back what it found; a Haiku subagent is handed over too once its context passes 100K tokens, where it bills at its long-prompt rate. off: no guard.

keepWarm.title: Keep the prompt cache warm
keepWarm.description: How long after your last turn the main conversation's prompt cache is kept warm, by a short ping just before it would expire. A ping reads the cache, a 25th of the price of writing it again on a 5-minute cache; on a 1-hour cache no ping is needed within an hour. off: no pings.
